sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Shekhar Gangal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Abhishek Gupta,G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.
Short counter affidavit filed on behalf of the informant/victim is taken on record.

2. Heard counsel for the applicant, Sri Abhishek Gupta, counsel for the opposite party no.
2/informant, Sri Neeraj Kumar Sharma, learned A.G.A. for the State- opposite party and perused the material placed on record.
3. This application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 75 of 2023, under Sections 376 and 506 I.P.C., Police Station- Rorawar, District- Aligarh.
4. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
The applicant was not involved in the alleged incident.

After investigation, final report in Rahbar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180437495/
1 favour of the applicant was submitted by the Investigating Officer on 18.12.2023.

sentences.text: On the basis of protest petition, the applicant has been summoned by the concerned court.
During the pendency of the proceedings, the informant/victim has also submitted an affidavit that the applicant had not committed any rape on her nor he was involved in the alleged incident.
The affidavit of the informant is annexed as Annexure No. 12 to the bail application.
The applicant had cooperated in the investigation.
No custodial interrogation is required.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents.

It is next submitted that the applicant has apprehension of his arrest and in case, the applicant is released on anticipatory bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
5.
Sri Abhishek Gupta, counsel for the informant, does not dispute the submissions raised by counsel for the applicant.
On the basis of instructions, he submits that the informant has no objection if the present application is allowed.
6. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

7. Having regard to the submissions made by counsel for the applicant, considering the nature of accusations, antecedents of the applicant, and, in particular, the fact that the applicant had cooperated in the investigation and no custodial interrogation is required, the fact that the informant/victim has submitted an affidavit in the concerned court that the applicant had not committed any rape on her nor he was involved in the alleged incident, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
In default of any of the conditions, the court concerned is at liberty to pass appropriate orders for enforcing and compelling the same.

10. The application stands disposed of.
